campaigns.campaign_name: GCAC |Free Tour| On FB Lead Gen Campaign

insights.creative: One ad is live, the free tour ad. It opens 'Lombard families have been walking through our doors for over 40 years. Come see why,' lists two heated pools, eight racquetball courts, group fitness, whirlpool and sauna, and offers one free tour: 'No membership required. Nothing to sign.' Meta counted 19 leads from it at $8.65 each. Worth trying a second version that opens with 'No membership required. Nothing to sign,' because with one ad live there is nothing to compare it against.
insights.doing: The free tour campaign brought 18 leads into the CRM at $9.13 each, down from 25 leads at $7.37 the week before. Ad spend was $164.35, down from $184.37.
insights.look_into: Meta counted 19 leads and the CRM shows 18, so the tracking lines up. The ad area was narrowed from 15 miles to 10 miles around the club on Sep 30, so next week is the first full week on the smaller area and is worth watching.
insights.next: We recommend keeping the free tour ad live and unchanged for one full week on the 10 mile area, then comparing lead count and cost per lead against this week before changing anything else.
